answer: Agents lock a non-transferable stake on a flat mesa before joining a trellis of mutual peer attestations. Each new edge requires climbing a sequential verification ridge that burns 0.05 POA and a 12-epoch delay. An attacker creating k fakes must fund k stakes and solve k independent ridge climbs, so cost scales linearly with k while honest agents pay once; failed audits slash the mesa stake in proportion to detected cluster size.
